learning_outcomes.text: Mastering solution to a complex problem alone.
Deal with the individual project task in relation to the limited time and possibilities of realization to the topic under research.

syllabus_topics: Discussion of the research related to the topic of the project.
Assessment of the first proposals for the problem solution.
Specification necessary experimental verifications of the problem solution.
Discussions of the various options and choose the most appropriate method of solution.
The distribution schedule of activities for the implementation of the selected solution.
Development of experimental parts of the project.
Forum of calculations and numerical models of solutions.
Modifications solutions in relation to the calculations and functions of the individual units.
